about: What lean_mpas does with every MPAS 8.4.2 Registry option, in Registry order: status (use, ignore, fixed, warn, scheme or mpas), why, and for some statuses the allowed values or MPAS's range.

config_time_integration.why: MPAS 8.4.2 logs an error for any value other than 'SRK3' and runs on; lean has only SRK3 and stops.

config_time_integration_order.why: Lean uses this MPAS dynamics integration setting at its Registry default.

config_dt.why: Sets the clock and dynamics timestep at start.

config_calendar_type.why: Lean's clock and solar day use the Gregorian calendar.

config_split_dynamics_transport.why: Lean uses this MPAS dynamics integration setting at its Registry default.

config_number_of_sub_steps.why: Lean uses this MPAS dynamics integration setting at its Registry default.

config_dynamics_split_steps.why: Lean uses this MPAS dynamics integration setting at its Registry default.

config_h_mom_eddy_visc2.why: Lean uses Smagorinsky mixing without fixed eddy viscosity.

config_h_mom_eddy_visc4.why: Lean uses Smagorinsky mixing without fixed eddy viscosity.

config_v_mom_eddy_visc2.why: Lean uses Smagorinsky mixing without fixed eddy viscosity.

config_h_theta_eddy_visc2.why: Lean uses Smagorinsky mixing without fixed eddy viscosity.

config_h_theta_eddy_visc4.why: Lean uses Smagorinsky mixing without fixed eddy viscosity.

config_v_theta_eddy_visc2.why: Lean uses Smagorinsky mixing without fixed eddy viscosity.

config_horiz_mixing.why: Lean has the two-dimensional Smagorinsky mixing path.

config_les_surface.why: Only LES uses this setting, and lean stops on LES.

config_surface_heat_flux.why: Only LES uses this setting, and lean stops on LES.

config_surface_moisture_flux.why: Only LES uses this setting, and lean stops on LES.

config_surface_drag_coefficient.why: Only LES uses this setting, and lean stops on LES.

config_len_disp.why: Effective length from the namelist or nominalMinDc, applied at start.

config_visc4_2dsmag.why: Sets this dynamics coefficient at start.

config_mix_scalars.why: Lean does not mix the scalar fields.

config_del4u_div_factor.why: Sets this dynamics coefficient at start.

config_w_adv_order.why: MPAS declares this option but never reads it.

config_theta_adv_order.why: MPAS declares this option but never reads it.

config_scalar_adv_order.why: MPAS declares this option but never reads it.

config_u_vadv_order.why: MPAS declares this option but never reads it.

config_w_vadv_order.why: MPAS declares this option but never reads it.

config_theta_vadv_order.why: MPAS declares this option but never reads it.

config_scalar_vadv_order.why: MPAS declares this option but never reads it.

config_positive_definite.why: MPAS warns that positive-definite advection is unimplemented and true enables monotonic transport; lean writes the same warning.

config_coef_3rd_order.why: Sets this dynamics coefficient at start.

config_smagorinsky_coef.why: Sets this dynamics coefficient at start.

config_epssm.why: MPAS warns that config_epssm is unsupported and directs users to the height-dependent settings; lean writes the same warning.

config_smdiv.why: Sets this dynamics coefficient at start.

config_apvm_upwinding.why: Sets the amount of upwinding in APVM, as MPAS applies it; MPAS's Registry range is 0 to 1.

config_h_ScaleWithMesh.why: Lean's horizontal mixing scales with the mesh.

config_num_halos.why: Lean runs as one process without MPI or PIO.

config_relax_zone_divdamp_coef.why: Sets this dynamics coefficient at start.

config_zd.why: Sets this damping parameter at start.

config_xnutr.why: Sets this damping parameter at start.

config_mpas_cam_coef.why: Lean does not have CAM damping.

config_number_cam_damping_levels.why: Only CAM damping uses this setting, and lean stops on CAM damping.

config_rayleigh_damp_u.why: Lean does not have Rayleigh damping of horizontal wind.

config_rayleigh_damp_u_timescale_days.why: Only Rayleigh damping uses this setting, and lean stops on Rayleigh damping.

config_number_rayleigh_damp_u_levels.why: Only Rayleigh damping uses this setting, and lean stops on Rayleigh damping.

config_epssm_minimum.why: Sets this damping parameter at start.

config_epssm_maximum.why: Sets this damping parameter at start.

config_epssm_transition_bottom_z.why: Sets this damping parameter at start.

config_epssm_transition_top_z.why: Sets this damping parameter at start.

config_apply_lbcs.why: Enables lateral boundaries; checked against bdyMaskCell.

config_restart_timestamp_name.why: Names the restart timestamp file, written after each restart record and read with config_start_time = 'file'.

config_pio_num_iotasks.why: Lean runs as one process without MPI or PIO.

config_pio_stride.why: Lean runs as one process without MPI or PIO.

config_block_decomp_file_prefix.why: Lean runs as one process without MPI or PIO.

config_number_of_blocks.why: Lean runs as one process without MPI or PIO.

config_explicit_proc_decomp.why: Lean runs as one process without MPI or PIO.

config_proc_decomp_file_prefix.why: Lean runs as one process without MPI or PIO.

config_do_restart.why: Read a lean_mpas restart from the restart stream and continue the forecast.

config_do_DAcycling.why: Lean does not have data assimilation or DA cycling.

config_print_global_minmax_vel.why: When true, writes the global velocity extrema to the log after every step.

config_print_detailed_minmax_vel.why: When true, writes the detailed velocity extrema to the log after every step (summarize_timestep).

config_print_global_minmax_sca.why: When true, writes the scalar extrema to the log after every step (summarize_timestep).

config_IAU_window_length_s.why: Only IAU uses this setting, and lean stops on IAU.

config_jedi_da.why: Lean does not have data assimilation or DA cycling.

config_halo_exch_method.why: Lean runs as one process without MPI or PIO.

config_gpu_aware_mpi.why: Lean runs as one process without MPI or PIO.

input_soil_data.why: Only Noah uses this setting, and lean has Noah-MP.

input_soil_temperature_lag.why: Only the deep-soil update uses this setting, and lean stops on that update.

naerlev.why: Lean does not use the aerosol climatology.

camdim1.why: Only CAM radiation uses this setting, and lean has RRTMG.

config_sfc_albedo.why: Lean uses the surface albedo input.

config_sfc_snowalbedo.why: Only Noah uses this setting, and lean has Noah-MP.

config_sst_update.why: Updates the sea-surface temperature and sea ice from the records of the 'surface' stream, every input_interval of that stream.

config_sstdiurn_update.why: Lean does not have the diurnal SST update.

config_deepsoiltemp_update.why: Lean does not have the deep-soil temperature update.

config_microp_re.why: Uses Thompson's effective radii in the radiation when true, RRTMG's own radii when false.

config_ysu_pblmix.why: Only YSU uses this setting, and lean has MYNN.

config_urban_physics.why: Lean does not have urban physics.

config_n_microp.why: MPAS declares this option but never reads it.

config_microphysics_top.why: Stops if the model top exceeds this height because lean runs microphysics on every level.

config_radtlw_interval.why: Sets this radiation alarm interval at start.

config_radtsw_interval.why: Sets this radiation alarm interval at start.

config_conv_interval.why: Lean runs convection and PBL physics every step.

config_pbl_interval.why: Lean runs convection and PBL physics every step.

config_camrad_abs_update.why: Only CAM radiation uses this setting, and lean has RRTMG.

config_greeness_update.why: Sets the greenness alarm interval; 'none' means every step.

config_bucket_update.why: Lean does not have bucket updates.

config_physics_suite.why: Resolves the nine physics schemes from the suite, as MPAS does.

config_microp_scheme.why: Lean has Thompson microphysics, or none ('off').

config_convection_scheme.why: Lean has Grell-Freitas convection, or none ('off').

config_lsm_scheme.why: Lean has Noah-MP land physics, or none ('off').

config_pbl_scheme.why: Lean has the MYNN planetary boundary layer, or none ('off').

config_gwdo_scheme.why: Lean has YSU gravity-wave drag, or none ('off').

config_ngw_scheme.why: Lean does not have non-orographic gravity-wave drag.

config_knob_ugwp_tauamp.why: Only UGWP uses this setting, and lean stops on UGWP.

config_ugwp_diags.why: Lean does not write UGWP diagnostics.

config_radt_cld_scheme.why: Lean has the cloud-fraction scheme and cld_incidence; 'off' becomes cld_incidence while radiation runs.

config_radt_lw_scheme.why: Lean has RRTMG longwave radiation, or none ('off').

config_radt_sw_scheme.why: Lean has RRTMG shortwave radiation, or none ('off').

config_sfclayer_scheme.why: Lean has the MYNN surface layer, or none ('off').

config_radt_cld_dcorrlen.why: Only exponential cloud overlaps use this setting, and lean stops on that overlap method.

config_gfconv_closure_deep.why: Lean uses the Registry closure setting for Grell-Freitas convection.

config_gfconv_closure_shallow.why: Lean uses the Registry closure setting for Grell-Freitas convection.

config_bucket_rainc.why: Only buckets use this setting, and lean stops on bucket updates.
